entries.en: It's Ryuji...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, it's me! Where you at?[n]Whatcha doin'?
Watching the store.
I'm out on the town.
It's a secret.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Gotcha!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Bull. Shit. I don't hear any other sounds.[n]Heh, I bet you're at home, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Pfft! Don't be such an ass! I bet you're[n]at home, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna come over right now[n]about the you-know-what. Seeya!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: 'Sup? We're here to hang out.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's not why we're here! We need to[n]study for finals!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *sigh* Why am I here too?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're one of us now, so of course you[n]gotta help us. We're in trouble if you[n]don't teach us, you know?
That's right.
I don't need to study.
But I don't wanna...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even you're saying such things?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ohoho, oh, I'll hold you to that! Wanna[n]see who gets the higher test scores?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I understand, man.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's leave those guys be...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I couldn't ask the last time I was here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But what is this place? The storekeeper[n]doesn't seem to be around...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's where this guy lives.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He's got complicated circumstances...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can tell her about it, right? Actually,[n]tell her yourself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's... That's terrible...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ann, Yusuke, and me are pretty much[n]the same too. I mean, it's not as bad as[n]this guy's though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's just something we can't ever[n]put up with. That's why we all became[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, don't forget me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know, I know. We're all part of[n]the team.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, Makoto, ain't there someone[n]you can't forgive either? Like, a heart[n]you wanna change?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...That's a secret.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ooh, there's someone like that? You[n]could just tell us, you know. You don't[n]gotta be so cold.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That aside, do you have any intention[n]of studying for the exams?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not really...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's fine if I leave then?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No, no, I'm just joking! Please teach us...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hmm, what was this term? It's "phobia,"[n]so it's a fear of some kind...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think it's a fear of open spaces. You[n]don't hear it that often, though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Leave vocabulary and long sentences to[n]me. I suck at proper grammar, though...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Even if we study English,[n]it's not like I'm gonna[n]use it in the future.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When it comes to you, your Japanese is[n]questionable too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aw shuddup!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Explain the writer's feelings...? What[n]point is there in that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's impossible! I can't memorize all these[n]formulas... Ain't there a good way[n]of cheatin'?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Why don't we take a break?

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: ...And that was the follow-up report on[n]the suspect Kaneshiro. Now, Akechi-san...

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: This case is said to be the result of[n]the Phantom Thieves' actions, but[n]in actuality, is this true?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Considering how a calling card was[n]scattered about, I believe there's no[n]mistaking that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The question is what the Phantom[n]Thieves actually did.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If they tampered with a suspect's heart,[n]it casts doubt on the authenticity of any[n]confession.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: So then, by tampering with hearts,[n]the Phantom Thieves are fabricating[n]crimes that may not exist?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We can't deny the possibility.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There's no doubt that the Phantom[n]Thieves are exposing hidden injustices[n]in society.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: However, if this is done by sidestepping[n]the law, their way of thinking is very[n]dangerous.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: So in a way, they're outlaws.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yes. They're no different than the[n]criminals they target. This cannot be[n]overlooked.

entries.speaker: TV Reporter
entries.en: I see.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "I see," my ass. Why the hell're we bein'[n]treated as the bad guys?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Just let them say whatever they want.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More people are starting to understand[n]that what we're doing is right, after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When I'm walkin' around in town, I hear[n]a lot more people talkin' about us too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And the forum's been full of hype![n]Do you think we made it big time?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't get pompous over dealing with[n]some street thug. Save it for after we[n]deal with a bigger target.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We just gotta take down a bigger one,[n]yeah?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That was the plan from the start,[n]anyways!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True, it may be best if we start thinking[n]about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I bet we'll find one in no time. The wind's[n]blowin' in our direction and everything!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I feel like we won't lose to anything[n]right now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, we'll decide on that eventually.[n]We need to overcome our exams first.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now then, break time's over! Let's get[n]back to—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That reminds me—the celebration party.[n]Weren't we gonna do it after exams?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, I believe so.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where should we go? I feel like I'll[n]study better if I got something to look[n]forward to.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The last one was a buffet at a hotel.[n]We haven't gone anywhere since.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Hm!? A buffet!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Where would be good?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, what about fireworks!? A fireworks[n]festival!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, it's that season, huh!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That sounds good to me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's hard to ignore a buffet, but I'll take[n]the beauties of summer.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Still, I demand that we feast during[n]the festival as well.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Do you guys own a yukata? Will you[n]wear a yukata!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Doesn't a fireworks festival sound good?[n]You think so too, right?
It's a great idea.
Not really.
But it's hot out...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Take a hint, will ya!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, you gotta be more active!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, fireworks festival it is! Let's look[n]for a good one!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Study comes first, though. I won't let you[n]off if you fail any of them. Are we clear?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y-Yes, ma'am...
